title: VP of Sales

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: With 65+ locations serving sign manufacturers, vehicle wrap installers, and large-format graphics companies nationwide, the VP of Sales owns revenue growth, customer acquisition, and the go-to-market strategy for Grimco's protective film portfolio. This executive is measured on: (1) year-over-year sales growth across regions, (2) market share gains against competing distributors, (3) customer retention through superior product offerings, and (4) new account development in high-value segments like architectural graphics and fleet graphics. Tedlar provides powerful sales enablement tools: the 12-20+ year lifespan claim is a compelling differentiator in consultative selling to quality-focused customers; the graffiti resistance feature solves a specific, costly pain point for transit, municipal, and retail signage buyers; and the DuPont brand credibility opens doors with enterprise accounts requiring validated performance data. Given Grimco's strong showing at industry trade shows and their FASTSIGNS Vendor of the Year recognition, sales leadership would immediately recognize Tedlar's potential to win premium projects where competing overlaminates fail. The product enables Grimco's sales teams to position value over price, expand wallet share with existing fabricator customers, and penetrate emerging markets like building wraps and architectural panels where extreme durability is non-negotiable.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: [Name] leads revenue strategy and sales execution across Grimco's 65+ North American and UK distribution locations. This role owns go-to-market decisions for protective film product lines, determines which brands get priority positioning with field sales teams, and manages relationships with high-value fabricator and installer accounts. As VP of Sales for a $241.8M distributor, [Name] likely reports to the CEO/President and oversees regional sales directors and account management teams. This role has significant influence over product portfolio decisions because sales leadership drives demand for products that help teams win competitive deals and expand customer relationships.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: Grimco's customer base spans sign manufacturers, vehicle wrap installers, and large-format graphics producers who face real-world durability challenges with current overlaminate options. Tedlar's extreme UV resistance and weather durability would enable Grimco's sales teams to win premium outdoor signage projects where clients demand proven performance beyond standard 3-5 year warranties. The graffiti resistance capability directly addresses pain points for municipal signage, transit graphics, and retail storefront applications where vandalism drives costly replacements. For vehicle wrap and fleet graphics customers, Tedlar's temperature range (-70°F to 230°F) and no-yellowing guarantee solve problems with film degradation on commercial vehicles operating in extreme climates. The architectural graphics and building wrap segment represents a growth opportunity where Grimco currently may lack a proven solution for 10+ year exterior installations—Tedlar fills this portfolio gap with verified field performance.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: [Name] is measured on year-over-year revenue growth, market share gains against competing distributors like Fellers and Denco, customer retention rates, and new account acquisition in strategic segments. Sales leadership cares deeply about competitive differentiation—having exclusive or preferred access to a premium product line that competitors cannot easily match. Tedlar solves a critical sales enablement challenge: giving field teams a credible answer to 'How is this different from 3M or Avery?' when fabricators push back on pricing. Reduced warranty claims and customer complaints directly impact sales team credibility and account retention. The DuPont brand heritage opens doors with enterprise buyers (municipalities, national fleets, architectural firms) who require third-party validation and performance data that regional overlaminate brands cannot provide. For a VP measured on both volume and margin, Tedlar represents an opportunity to elevate Grimco's positioning from commodity distributor to premium solutions provider.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: Grimco maintains active presence at ISA Sign Expo and Printing United trade shows, where new product introductions generate immediate field sales interest and customer inquiries. The company's 10 consecutive years winning FASTSIGNS Vendor of the Year recognition demonstrates commitment to product innovation and premium positioning—suggesting openness to differentiated offerings that reinforce this reputation. With 65+ locations and a national sales force, Grimco would be preparing for FY2026 sales planning cycles where new product line decisions are made. The sign and graphics industry is experiencing growth in architectural and building wrap applications, creating demand for overlaminates that can support 10-20 year exterior installations. Now is an opportune time to position Tedlar as a strategic addition before competitors secure similar partnerships with other distributors.

personalization_hooks.hook: Grimco's sales teams compete daily against Fellers, Denco, and regional distributors carrying similar 3M/Avery/Orafol portfolios, creating pressure to differentiate on price rather than performance
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Frame Tedlar as a competitive weapon that enables value-based selling conversations. Position this as solving the 'How do we win premium projects without discounting?' challenge that field sales leaders face in commoditized markets.

personalization_hooks.hook: The VP of Sales owns revenue growth in emerging segments like architectural graphics and building wraps where standard overlaminates fail to meet 10+ year performance requirements
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Lead with market opportunity: 'We're seeing architectural and transit specifiers demand verified 15-20 year performance data that traditional films can't support. Tedlar opens access to projects your teams may be walking away from today.' Position as a growth enabler, not just another SKU.

personalization_hooks.hook: Grimco has earned FASTSIGNS Vendor of the Year for 10 consecutive years by delivering innovation that helps franchisees win and retain customers
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Acknowledge their reputation for premium solutions and position Tedlar as reinforcing this brand promise. Frame the conversation around 'protecting your teams from warranty callbacks and customer complaints that damage fabricator relationships'—a sales retention issue, not just a product feature.

recommended_approach: Lead with competitive differentiation and sales enablement angle rather than technical specifications. Frame Tedlar as solving a go-to-market challenge (how to win premium projects and justify pricing) rather than presenting it as another overlaminate option. Reference Grimco's premium market positioning and trade show presence to demonstrate understanding of their business model. Keep initial outreach focused on exploring portfolio gaps in ultra-premium segment rather than pushing for immediate product evaluation.
